note: Per-task routing receipt for the SuperScout router at its calibrated operating point theta = 0.30. The router is the released blend head (code/router/router_head.npz + router_spec.json); every probability and decision below recomputes deterministically from those artifacts over the released feature arrays.
theta_calibration: Calibrated on the 99-task label-run with-handoff outcomes via the matched-point rule (weights and resumes unchanged from the freeze); no evaluation-benchmark data in the selection.
route_rule: first fixer in cheap_order with p_blend >= theta, else anchor
fallback_note: no task fell through to the anchor at theta = 0.30, so the anchor choice does not affect this cell

reference_no_router_kimi.note: blanket Kimi K2.5 + handoff on all 266 tasks (no router), same composition convention

cost_convention: fixer cost = sum of the routed fixer's episode cost_usd_pinned over the 266 tasks (outcomes_per_task.json system_union_pairs); total cost adds the searcher-side flat $5.13 once (not per task); cost_per_task = total / 266; cost_per_solve = total / solved
probability_vectors_note: per task x fixer: p_text (text-only head), p_state (hidden-state head), p_blend (uniform average of the two; the routing head). Deterministic outputs of the released frozen head over the released feature arrays, rounded to 6 decimals; enables re-thresholding and calibration analyses.
